description:
Key Responsibilities: 
 - Build and Test interfaces for SOA Integrations using Oracle fusion middleware SOA suite and service bus (OSB) 
 - Gathering business and technical requirements for communication between the CRM and other legacy and external systems. 
 - Finalize technology and architecture details related to the integration solution 
 - Strong hands on experience in Oracle Fusion Middleware SOA suite (BPEL, Mediator etc.) and/or Oracle Service Bus (OSB) 
 - Familiarity with Open source standards for integration including XML, WSDL, SOAP etc. 
 - Implementation experience using Oracle SOA Suite and Oracle Service Bus(OSB). 
 - Experienced in troubleshooting SOA/OSB code in Production environment with high volume transaction 
 - Proficient in Oracle Weblogic Server tuning and troubleshooting 

 Minimum skills and qualifications: 
 - Some evening / weekend work will be required 
 - United States Citizenship required (no dual citizenship)
 - U.S. Public Trust clearance required 
 - 4 or more years experience of OracleSOA/OSB 
 - 4 or more years experienceof Oracle Weblogic 10.3.6+ 
 - Good communication 
 - Web service development experience using Oracle SOA suite 11g (BPEL, and OSB) or any other equivalent technology for the middleware integration such JAVA etc. 
 - Familiarity with XML, WSDL, SOAP etc. 
 
 Preferred skills and qualifications: 
 - Linux Operating System 
 - MS Office 2010 
 - Experience in Oracle SOA suite 11g is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of Oracle database, SQL and PL/SQL is a plus but not required. 

 **  Please share me your updated word copy of Resume. 

 *** I Appreciate, if you can  refer  someone who is looking for this position.
